title: Folly Beach Dolphin Viewing Boat Excursion and Estuary Tour
includes: USCG Licensed Captain and Eco Guide
27' Carolina Skiff with Cushioned Bench Seating
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us out on the water for sunrise, sunset, or somewhere in between in a search for our favorite saltwater mammal – the bottlenose dolphin!
On this trip, we will cruise through the local tidal creeks behind Folly Beach to see how many of these amazing creatures we can spot. From a distance, you will get to experience the unique feeding techniques and socializing behaviors that our dolphins display out in the wild. Along the way, your experienced guide and certified captain will teach you all about our salt marsh estuary. You will also get to pass by the historic Morris Island Lighthouse during the trip, a great photo opportunity!
This is the perfect trip for families, couples, and friends alike.
We are a small, locally owned business who strives to make all of our guests experience unique, personable and unforgettable while visiting Charleston!
If you are interested in making this experience private, contact us directly.
